title: TEL-001 Relationship Truth Audit
objective: Determine whether Enterprise Programme and Opportunity relationships are present in the governed TEL-001 package or are being lost by Flora.
implementation_summary: Audited all 308 governed Relationship records and all 50 Membership records directly from the checksum-verified repository fixture.
Compared explicit source associations for all six Enterprises with the current Flora zero-Programme/zero-Opportunity page evidence.
Published a human-readable Executive Summary and complete record-level truth report without changing semantic runtime behaviour.
expected_visible_outcomes: Source relationship truth by Enterprise is visible through the linked Executive Summary and complete audit report.
Source-versus-Flora comparison gives an explicit conclusion for each of the six Enterprises.
The audit distinguishes Flora runtime loss from Researcher/package-contract gaps, including the unlinked BT/Verizon Programme.
No importer, validator, resolver, semantic, governance, promotion, Programme, or Opportunity behaviour changes.
unchanged_areas: Importer, validator, relationship resolver, semantic construction, Canonical Factual Projection, Enterprise association logic, Opportunity logic, Programme logic, governance, promotion, the TEL-001 fixture, and Researcher package contents remain unchanged.
required_test_steps: Open the TEL-001 Relationship Truth Executive Summary from this panel.
Confirm all six Enterprise conclusions and the BT/Verizon Programme and Opportunity traces.
Confirm the complete report reconciles 308 Relationships and classifies 50 Memberships.
fresh_import_policy: Fresh import is required only when the approved change is live and material runtime components that affect candidate representation changed before the candidate was imported. UI-only, presentation-only and diagnostics-only panel changes do not require reimport. If timestamps or component classification are unavailable, Flora reports Cannot determine rather than forcing a reimport.
known_limitations: The panel links to the repository Markdown artefact; deployments that do not serve repository documentation may require opening the same path in the source repository.

automated_validation.known_failing_tests: None in focused population/relationship acceptance suite.

operator_validation_status: PASS — immutable fixture reconciled; documentation and presentation only
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
fresh_import_required: No — this audit does not change candidate representation or semantic runtime behaviour.
